proposed_fixes.title: PowerToys Run results flicker while typing new characters
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Each query update may clear or hide current results before asynchronous plugin results arrive, producing visible flicker at short configured delays.
plan: Trace query generations, result-list clearing, and delayed plugin completions for Everything and Calculator.
Retain the last valid result list until a newer query generation has results, without allowing stale results to become selectable.
Add tests for rapid per-character updates and slow/empty plugin results.
verification: Type rapidly into PowerToys Run with the affected plugin and verify the list stays visible while results update for the current query.

confidence.rationale: Current query-generation logic may still clear results on every keystroke, but the report predates current PowerToys Run code.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting the exact 0 ms/1 ms delays and that Everything flickered on v0.85.1 while Calculator had an empty-intermediate-query case. Could you confirm the current PowerToys version and whether flicker still occurs with Everything, Calculator, or both? If it occurs, please include a short query and say whether intermediate text has zero results. This distinguishes list clearing from a plugin’s empty result response.
